## History

John Douglas courted [Janet](../character/janet.md) for twenty years, though he was bound by a secret deathbed vow made to his mother to delay proposing to her. When [Janet](../character/janet.md) rejected his offer to walk her home after a prayer meeting, John appeared stricken, leading [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to intervene and reunite them. After his mother eventually passed away, John immediately proposed to [Janet](../character/janet.md) and revealed the secret agreement, leading [Janet](../character/janet.md) to forgive his late mother and accept his proposal.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Douglas P3](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0003), [v3 ch.Douglas P5](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0005), [v3 ch.Douglas P6](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0006), [v3 ch.Douglas P11](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0011), [v3 ch.Douglas P12](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0012), [v3 ch.Douglas P20](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0020), +71 more_

## Relationships

### [Janet](../character/janet.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/janet--john-douglas.md)

John Douglas has courted [Janet](../character/janet.md) for twenty years, offering to walk her home after prayer meetings, though his failure to propose long caused her immense distress. Their courtship was secretly stalled by a deathbed vow John made to his mother, forcing him to keep his intentions hidden for nineteen years. Following his mother's death, John finally proposes to [Janet](../character/janet.md), explaining the delay and securing her forgiveness and acceptance.
